---
name: Report a defect
about: Describe a problem and the steps that cause it.
labels: bug
---

For a security problem, follow [the security policy](https://github.com/tidynotebook/tidynotebook/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Do not include passwords, tokens, private note text or account addresses.

## What happens

Describe the result. State what you expect to happen.

## Steps to reproduce

Give the steps with a small test note that contains no private information.

## Environment

State the application release, browser, operating system and edition.
For self-hosted use, state whether a reverse proxy is present.

## Evidence

Add an image or a short log extract if it helps. Remove private information
before you attach it.
